coverage.reason: Approval-only main-screen art draft mounted on the current real-game loopback benchmark. Cover new transparent artwork, scoped HUD skin, Current/New comparison, native desktop/landscape viewport controls, zoom-independent bounds, button hit targets, incoming/outgoing and effect states, preserved saved heraldry, mini-chat dimensions/background/arrow, timer width, image loading and runtime errors. Shared runtime files and backend rules are not modified; no production entry references this draft, so no emulator suite applies. Future production integration requires its own affected-dependency review.

Documents the audited current HUD sources, proposed style treatment and pending-approval status, asset provenance, measured validation boundaries and existing smallest-viewport overlap. Does not change the authoritative game specification or claim deployment.
